title: Desktop Lighting Studio device type
description: Reusable device-type definition (presets/devices/<id>.device.json). A workspace instance references it through devices.<instance>.type; the file basename (<id>.device.json) must equal "id". Entities are local parts (geometry + local transform) or child-device references (another type id + local transform — nested assemblies, recursion rejected). Zones generate emitters on their entity. Units: meters, Euler degrees (Rz*Ry*Rx).

id.description: Type id — must equal the file basename (<id>.device.json).

entities.description: Local parts and child-device references keyed by entity id. Expanded objects are named <instance path>/<entity id>.

type.description: Child device-type reference — mounts another preset at this local transform (nested assembly). Mutually exclusive with geometry/size_m/zone/appearance.

size_m.description: Body dimensions in meters; each component >= 0, 0 falls back to the geometry's canonical axis.

parent.description: Optional entity id inside this type — the entity-parent chain composes local transforms. Cycles rejected.

zone.description: Zone id this entity carries (must match a zones[] entry whose entity names this entity).

appearance.description: Authoring material hints (colors, roughness, ...) retained verbatim.

zones.description: Emitter-bearing zones; each generates emitters local to its entity.

entity.description: Entity carrying the LEDs (local part, not a child ref).

face_y_m.description: Emitter plane offset along the entity's +Y.

dynamic.description: matrix: emitters rebuilt from the bound zone's matrix map at runtime.

empty.description: matrix map sentinel for unmapped cells.

points.description: Explicit emitter positions for irregular hardware.

addresses.description: Optional per-point addresses; default = instance addr_base + index.

binding_hints.description: Informational compatible-hardware hints carried by the type (never per-instance serials; never grants verified). Known keys only — unknown keys are rejected as likely typos.
